business_problem: UIB needed a scalable, low-latency, and localized platform for conversational commerce so clients like Transnasional could own customer data, meet Malaysian data residency requirements, and move ticket sales off third-party agents.
solution_summary: UIB built a WhatsApp-based conversational commerce platform on Google Cloud for clients that need direct digital sales channels. The system runs on Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), which automatically scales with chatbot demand without requiring extra hardware, giving the company a reliable base for revenue-generating customer conversations. UIB added Gemini and Gemma to provide the natural-language layer for the ticketing experience, while Cloud Storage near Malaysia keeps customer information in a company-controlled environment that satisfies localization and latency requirements. In production, this architecture integrates with Transnasional's public transportation ticketing workflow so passengers can discover, book, and complete transactions through WhatsApp instead of external online travel agents. The result is a governed conversational commerce stack that combines messaging, AI, and localized storage on one cloud platform.

solution_components.name: Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE)
solution_components.role: Hosts the conversational commerce platform and automatically scales with chatbot traffic.

solution_components.name: Gemini
solution_components.role: Powers the natural-language capabilities in the conversational ticketing interface.

solution_components.name: Gemma
solution_components.role: Supports the natural-language experience used in the conversational interface.

solution_components.name: Cloud Storage
solution_components.role: Stores customer data near Malaysia to meet data residency and low-latency requirements.

data_flow: Passengers start on WhatsApp, where the UIB platform running on GKE handles traffic spikes, routes conversational requests through Gemini and Gemma for language understanding, and stores customer data in Cloud Storage located near Malaysia so Transnasional can complete ticket sales while keeping the data in its own environment.
business_outcome: The platform helped Transnasional move more than 60% of ticket sales to WhatsApp, retain 100% of its customer data, and replace OTA dependency with a direct conversational sales channel.
